# LayoutChild

One child of a [Layout](Layout.md), and how it is sized.

## Parameters

- `item`: A string. The element or layout placed. Optional.
- `width`: A string or single-key object (see [LayoutSize](LayoutSize.md)). How wide it is. Defaults to `"fit"`.
- `height`: A string or single-key object (see [LayoutSize](LayoutSize.md)). How tall it is. Defaults to `"fit"`.
